instruction: Refer to the document provided by my manager, then install the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Chrome plugins from the Chrome Web Store.

expected: Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing 3 Chrome extensions from the document (Speechify Text to Speech Voice Reader, React Developer Tools, and Momentum) - specifically the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th items in the list (excluding the header). The evaluator uses custom getter to retrieve installed extension names from Chrome Preferences file and custom metric to verify all 3 expected extensions are installed. Verified against the actual document content which lists these extensions at positions 3, 4, and 5.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts installed Chrome extension names from the Preferences file with proper OS-specific path handling
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('expected', []) to retrieve the list of required extensions
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement to install 3 specific extensions (2nd, 3rd, 4th from document)
Set subset comparison logic correctly verifies that all expected extensions are installed
State is accessible from persistent Chrome Preferences file; no special UI state or postconfig needed
Expected extension names match the instruction requirements and have been verified against actual document content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider implementing partial credit scoring (e.g., 0.33 per extension installed) instead of binary 0.0/1.0 to provide more granular feedback on task completion
